snippet.title: Skin Witch - New Trailer, Survival Horror
snippet.description:
Trapped in an underground mine you were sent to investigate, you soon learn you’re not alone. In the deep dark, skin-changed beasts lurk behind every corner as you struggle to escape. Fill them full of lead, or burn them to a crisp to make sure they stay dead. Skin Witch will be launching on PC this Spring.

Wishlist on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164990/Skin_Witch/

Credits:
Track 'W7' - Guild of Lore
